# right operand

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:rightOperand`](gmeow-rightOperand.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/rightOperand>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The value an atomic constraint tests against ([odrl:rightOperand](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/rightOperand)), e.g. "2030-01-01", "EU", "5". For an IRI-valued operand use [`gmeow:rightOperandReference`](gmeow-rightOperandReference.md).
